program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 11.0, 19.0),     # diff-pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.8, 0.5, 1.5),        # diff-pair L
    "gmidp": (9.0, 7.0, 12.0),       # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "Lp":    (0.8, 0.5, 1.5),        # PMOS mirror L
    "gmidt": (12.0, 9.0, 15.0),      # tail / bias mirror gm/Id
    "Lt":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # tail / bias mirror L
    "ratio": (8.0, 6.0, 8.0),        # Itail / Iref (power cap ~8)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    k = int(round(p["ratio"]))
    itail = k * iref
    i1 = itail / 2.0

    # differential pair (NMOS)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.6, vsb=0.0)
    vs = vcm - m1.vgs                       # tail node voltage
    # PMOS mirror load (diode-side Vds ~ Vgs)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i1, vds=0.7)
    # bias reference diode and tail: same L, gm/Id, same Vds -> exact W ratio k
    mr0 = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=0.6)
    vb = mr0.vgs
    mr = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=vb)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], itail, vds=vb)
    mt_op = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], itail, vds=max(vs, 0.15))

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MR", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mr)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # vinp drives the output-side device -> non-inverting from vinp
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)

    # ---- predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    gout = m1.gds + m3.gds
    a0 = gm1 / gout
    cout = cl + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cout)
    cx = 2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    fp2 = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cx)             # mirror pole, LHP zero at 2*fp2
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fp2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * fp2)))
    slew = itail / cout
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 4.6 * tau + 0.5 / slew
    # CMRR ~ 2*gm3*ro_tail (5T OTA)
    cmrr_db = db(2 * m3.gm / mt_op.gds)
    # PSRR(VDD) ~ gm1*ro_tail-ish for 5T OTA, conservatively A0
    psrr_db = db(a0)
    vout_lo = vs + 0.15
    vout_hi = vdd - abs(m3.vdsat) - 0.1
    swing = vout_hi - vout_lo
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    vn_th = math.sqrt(16 * kT / (3 * gm1) * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    noise = vn_th * 6.0                     # flicker multiplier at 1 kHz (rough)
    power = vdd * (iref + itail)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(a0), "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
        "settle": settle, "cmrr_db": cmrr_db, "psrr_db": psrr_db,
        "swing": swing, "noise_1k": noise, "power": power,
    }
